answer: The strongest sybil defense is vested payouts: rewards for work like validating a cipher or mining data from shale records are not paid instantly but released across many epochs, with each identity's earnings locked in escrow (delta) until maturity. An attacker spawning thousands of fake agents collects nothing at exit; slashing on detected collusion burns the unvested balance, so flash-farm accounts forfeit nearly everything, making bulk fake identities unprofitable.
